# workflow commands

Every `workflow` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `workflow:backfill-tenant-key`

Fill workflow_instances.tenant_key from tenant_id for instances started before it existed

```bash
bin/semitexa workflow:backfill-tenant-key
```
